title: Getting Ready for Work
context: The morning rush: alarm, shower, coffee, running late, commuting. The phrases you'd use to tell a colleague why you're five minutes late.
contextPersian: عجله صبح: زنگ ساعت، دوش، قهوه، دیر شدن، رفت‌وآمد. عبارت‌هایی که با آن به همکارت می‌گویی چرا پنج دقیقه دیر رسیدی.

expressions.example: My alarm goes off at six, but I never get up before six thirty.
expressions.examplePersian: ساعتم شش زنگ می‌زند ولی هیچ‌وقت قبل از شش‌ونیم بلند نمی‌شوم.
expressions.note: Goes off = rings. 'Turn off the alarm' = خاموش کردن.

expressions.example: I hit snooze three times this morning.
expressions.examplePersian: امروز صبح سه بار دکمه snooze را زدم.

expressions.example: I just have time to take a quick shower.
expressions.examplePersian: فقط وقت دارم یک دوش سریع بگیرم.

expressions.example: It takes me about forty minutes to get ready.
expressions.examplePersian: آماده شدنم حدود چهل دقیقه طول می‌کشد.

expressions.example: I'm running late — can we push the meeting fifteen minutes?
expressions.examplePersian: دارم دیر می‌رسم — می‌شود جلسه را پانزده دقیقه عقب بیندازیم؟
expressions.note: Running late = in the process of being late. More natural than 'I will be late' in the moment.

expressions.example: Hang on, let me grab my keys and we can go.
expressions.examplePersian: صبر کن کلیدهایم را بردارم تا برویم.

expressions.example: I usually head to work around eight.
expressions.examplePersian: معمولاً حدود هشت راهی سر کار می‌شوم.
expressions.note: Head to = go towards. Very common: head home, head out.

expressions.example: If I leave now, I can still catch the 8:15 bus.
expressions.examplePersian: اگر الان راه بیفتم هنوز به اتوبوس ۸:۱۵ می‌رسم.

expressions.example: Sorry I'm late — the traffic was terrible this morning.
expressions.examplePersian: ببخشید دیر کردم — ترافیک امروز صبح وحشتناک بود.

expressions.example: I work from home on Tuesdays, so no commute.

exercises.explanation: The alarm goes off = زنگ می‌زند.

exercises.prompt: You're going to arrive a bit late and want to tell a colleague now. The most natural message is:
exercises.explanation: 'I'm running late' is THE phrase for this moment.
exercises.explanationPersian: عبارت رایج برای همین لحظه: I'm running late.

exercises.prompt: If you leave now, you can still ___ the 8:15 bus.
exercises.explanation: Catch the bus/train = به آن رسیدن.
exercises.explanationPersian: رسیدن به اتوبوس: catch the bus.

exercises.source: ببخشید دیر کردم — ترافیک وحشتناک بود.
acceptedAnswers: Sorry I'm late — the traffic was terrible.
Sorry I'm late, the traffic was terrible.
Sorry I am late — the traffic was terrible.

speakingTask.instruction: Describe your morning from waking up to arriving at work.
speakingTask.instructionPersian: صبح خودت را از بیدار شدن تا رسیدن به محل کار توصیف کن.
modelSentences: My alarm goes off at six, and I usually hit snooze once.
I take a quick shower and get ready.
I grab my keys and head to work around eight.
When the traffic is terrible, I'm running late by ten minutes.

roleplay.aiRole: The learner's colleague on a quick morning call
roleplay.learnerRole: You're running late and calling a colleague to manage it
roleplay.objective: Explain the delay, ask them to cover, agree next steps
roleplay.context: The learner is stuck in traffic before a 9:00 stand-up. Call a colleague: explain, ask them to share your update, promise an ETA.
roleplay.opening: Hey, morning! You're usually here by now — everything okay?
